units.source_text: 我看见的是深红色的花，可是……”

en.t: What I saw was a deep crimson flower, but..."

units.source_text: 大辅命妇看见他讨厌红色的花，推想他必有用意。

en.t: When Dainagon no Myobu saw that he disliked red flowers, she guessed that he must have some intention behind it.

units.source_text: 便想起了自己偶尔借着月光看到小姐鼻尖的红色[\[16\]](#part1335.html#m16)。

en.t: Then she remembered how she herself had once happened to see, by moonlight, the redness at the tip of the young lady's nose[\[16\]](#part1335.html#m16).

units.source_text: 虽然可怜她，但觉得这首诗倒实在很滑稽。

en.t: Although she felt sorry for her, she thought the poem was truly quite comical.

units.source_text: 她便熟练地自言自语地吟道：

en.t: She then recited, as if murmuring to herself, with practiced ease:
